reason: An external-service integration plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to OAuth-protected Streamable HTTP MCP servers and exposes their discovered tools for agent use.

summaries.zh: 通过 OAuth 2.1 和 Streamable HTTP 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 MCP 服务，并发现、注册和执行远程工具。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to OAuth 2.1-protected Streamable HTTP MCP servers and enables discovery, registration, and execution of their remote tools.

capabilities: OAuth 2.1 authorization with PKCE and dynamic client registration
Browser-based login with a loopback callback
Persistent storage of OAuth tokens and client metadata through the DSH credential service
Streamable HTTP MCP connections with reconnect handling
Discovery, registration, and execution of tools exposed by remote MCP servers
Persistent configuration of MCP connections in a DSH Web profile
